newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent firms on tight cash market, Iraq worries.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent firms on tight cash market, Iraq worries.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were firmer on Friday in the wake of stronger numbers on the physical crude markets and lingering worries about the absence of Iraqi barrels from the market, traders said.
August Brent was 20 cents a barrel firmer at $18.05 at 1152 GMT while July gas oil was $1.25 stronger at $163 a tonne.
"It's all about the cash market," one trader said. "The spreads are firmer and cfds (contracts for difference) are stronger."
Traders in the physical markets attributed strength partly to the short-term tightness in the Atlantic basin.
